_comment: Per-category pipeline settings, read by scripts/daily_update.py. coverage_prior turns on the file-drawer correction (shrink toward a prior mean that depends on review count); it is set from the evidence in scripts/analyze_categories.py, not by default. max_review_lag_days re-dates bulk-imported reviews to the release date for effect lookups. exclude_release_types (music) drops reissues/deluxe editions/box sets, compilations and archival releases, as classified by scripts/release_types.py plus config/music_release_overrides.csv.
